ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-contrast distribution; approximately 70% high-intensity white pixels to 30% low-intensity black/dark-gray pixels across the visible ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: High-intensity white regions occupy the central and inner surfaces of both lobes. Low-intensity black pixels form a continuous peripheral band along the trailing edge, widening significantly at the distal tips and converging at the median notch. Vertical low-intensity mottling and streaks are present across the high-intensity fields.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep, acute V-shaped depression; calculated interior angle of approximately 35 degrees with a bounding-box depth approximately 15% of the total fluke height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous, high-frequency serration pattern across the entire trailing edge boundary; pixel-amplitude variations of 3-12 pixels create a highly irregular, jagged topography, most extreme at the distal tips.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: The superior margin of both lobes follows a convex curve that terminates in heavily textured, irregular distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: High-density clusters of dark, textured pixel groups (localized high-contrast clusters) are concentrated at the extreme distal margins of both lobes. Scattered low-intensity circular spots are visible throughout the white central regions.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Multiple distinct, unaligned low-intensity linear segments (rake marks) oriented vertically and diagonally across the white regions of both lobes, particularly visible in the mid-to-lower sections.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extreme irregular, three-dimensional pixel clusters on the distal tips indicative of significant bio-fouling or permanent tissue trauma; numerous deep, non-uniform notches along the trailing edge consistent with cumulative physical interaction.
other_distinctive_markers: A prominent, isolated dark vertical linear segment is located in the interior lower quadrant of the left lobe near the median notch.
